svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SE05x: Minimal application, no power cycle (SE050, SE051)
svg.desc: Schematic of the SE05x minimal application, no power cycle (se050, se051): the chip with U2 MCU, C1 capacitor 100 nF, R1 resistor 3.3 kΩ, R2 resistor 3.3 kΩ; the MCU wires carry the port hooks SetEnable() / PowerCycle(), Write() / Read().
svg.text: SE05x: Minimal application, no power cycle (SE050, SE051)
ENA tied to VCC and VCC on the supply: the chip runs, but the driver has no power-cycle rung, so a bus held by
errata I2C.1 or I2C.2 stays held until the board's supply is switched. Use only where the board can switch the
chip's supply itself. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: Table 5 Pin description
* Not confirmed in the datasheet: C1 100 nF: a usual decoupling value; the SE050 data sheet gives none.
